description: This file defines a FastAPI application with a data model `Item` and an endpoint to update items via PUT request. It includes Pydantic models for data validation and an API route that demonstrates usage of request bodies with examples.

classes.name: Item
classes.description: A Pydantic model representing an item with optional description and tax fields, and required name and price fields.

methods.name: update_item( item_id: int, item: Annotated[ Item, Body( examples=[ { "name": "Foo", "description": "A very nice Item", "price": 35.4, "tax": 3.2, } ], ), ], )
methods.description: An asynchronous API endpoint that updates an item based on the provided item ID and item data, returning the combined result.

ctags.name: update_item
